findings.claim: MoD resource+capital DEL 2024-25 ~£56.9B (Main Estimates)
findings.correct_value: UK defence spending 2024-25 was £60.2-60.3B per Commons Library (cash +£6.4B vs 2023-24); £56.9B understates the outturn.

findings.claim: UK defence spend ~2.3% GDP 2024-25 (NATO definition)
findings.correct_value: NATO-qualifying defence spending 2024-25 was 2.3% of GDP (2.33% in 2024).

findings.claim: NAO Equipment Plan 2023-33 £16.9B affordability gap (Dec 2023)
findings.correct_value: NAO Dec 2023: forecast costs £305.5B vs budget £288.6B = £16.9B gap; largest of any of 12 plans published.

findings.claim: Ajax AFV IOC July 2025 / Dec 2024
findings.correct_value: Ajax IOC was achieved 6 November 2025 (met in September by Household Cavalry Regiment), not Dec 2024 or July 2025.

findings.claim: 2.5% GDP target by 2027
findings.correct_value: Government committed Feb 2025 to 2.5% NATO defence spend by 2027.

findings.claim: Strategic Defence Review commissioned July 2024, reports Spring 2025
findings.correct_value: SDR commissioned by Healey Jul 2024, published June 2025 (first half 2025 window broadly accurate).

findings.claim: NHP Reset May 2025 Labour announcement (Streeting)
findings.correct_value: Streeting announced NHP review outcome January 2025 in the Commons (20 Jan 2025), not May 2025.

findings.claim: NAO July 2023 judged NHP unaffordable at £20B
findings.correct_value: NAO 'New Hospital Programme' (HC 1662) July 2023 flagged unfunded/undeliverable at original scope.

findings.claim: NHP backed by £15B new investment across 5-year waves (~£3B/yr)
findings.correct_value: Jan 2025 review confirms £15B over consecutive 5-year waves averaging £3B/year; wave zero-3 structure.

findings.claim: SoS DHSC transitions 4/5 Jul 2024 Atkins -> Streeting
findings.correct_value: Victoria Atkins SoS DHSC to 5 Jul 2024; Wes Streeting from 5 Jul 2024.

findings.claim: NHSE CE transition Mar/Apr 2025: Pritchard -> Mackey interim
findings.correct_value: Amanda Pritchard stepped down as NHSE CE end-Mar 2025; Sir Jim Mackey took over as transition CE April 2025.

findings.claim: NHP pledged March 2020 by Boris Johnson — 40 new hospitals by 2030
findings.correct_value: Johnson government confirmed 'Health Infrastructure Plan'/40 hospitals pledge late 2019-early 2020.

key: R&D Tax Credits: Above The Line

findings.claim: RDEC rate 13% to 20% on 1 April 2023
findings.correct_value: RDEC gross rate raised from 13% to 20% for expenditure on/after 1 April 2023.

findings.claim: Merged R&D scheme effective 1 April 2024 via Finance Act 2024
findings.correct_value: Merged scheme applies to accounting periods beginning on or after 1 April 2024; 20% RDEC-style above-the-line credit.

findings.claim: ERIS intensity threshold lowered from 40% to 30% from April 2024
findings.correct_value: ERIS threshold reduced to 30% R&D intensity from 1 April 2024.

findings.claim: HMRC SME fraud/error estimate 2020-21: £1.04B (24.4%)
findings.correct_value: HMRC July 2023 estimate — SME scheme error/fraud £1.04B (24.4%) for 2020-21.

findings.claim: Additional Information Form mandatory 8 August 2023
findings.correct_value: AIF mandatory from 8 August 2023 for all R&D claims.

findings.claim: Tavistock GIDS dissolved Apr 2024 — Cass Review final report
findings.correct_value: GIDS underwent managed closure 31 March 2024; Cass Review final report published 10 April 2024. Tavistock & Portman Trust itself was not dissolved — it remains operational; wind-up into NELFT pending.

findings.claim: GOSH ~650 beds
findings.correct_value: GOSH has ~400 beds (publicly cited current figure), not 650.

findings.claim: Royal Brompton & Harefield merged into Guy's and St Thomas' Feb 2021
findings.correct_value: Royal Brompton & Harefield NHS FT merged into Guy's & St Thomas' NHS FT 1 February 2021.

findings.claim: Cass Review final report April 2024
findings.correct_value: Cass Review final report published 10 April 2024.

findings.claim: NHSE Specialised Commissioning ~£24B/yr
findings.correct_value: NHSE specialised services budget ~£24B annually (2024-25); delegated increasingly to ICBs from April 2024.

findings.claim: Rwanda scheme scrapped 6 July 2024 by PM Starmer (day 2)
findings.correct_value: Starmer announced scrapping 6 July 2024 (two days after 4 July election).

findings.claim: Small-boat arrivals 2024: ~36,800 (vs 29,437 in 2023)
findings.correct_value: 2024 small-boat arrivals 36,816; 2023 = 29,437 per Home Office & Commons Library.

findings.claim: Manston Oct-Nov 2022: ~4,000 in 1,600-capacity site, diphtheria outbreak
findings.correct_value: Autumn 2022 >4,000 at site designed for 1,600; diphtheria outbreak (~50 cases), scabies, MRSA; one death (Hussein Haseeb Ahmed, 19 Nov 2022).

findings.claim: Rwanda total sunk cost ~£700M (£290M to Rwanda + £240M running etc.)
findings.correct_value: Home Secretary Cooper Jul 2024: total ~£700M including £290M to Rwanda, flights, detention/release, civil service staffing.

findings.claim: Bibby Stockholm closed Jan 2025
findings.correct_value: Bibby Stockholm stopped housing asylum seekers end of January 2025 after Labour declined to renew contract.

findings.claim: Home Secretary Yvette Cooper; Border Security & Asylum Minister Dame Angela Eagle
findings.correct_value: Cooper appointed Home Secretary 5 Jul 2024; Eagle Minister for Border Security & Asylum from Jul 2024.

findings.claim: AASC contract £4.6B original to £15.3B projected (NAO Mar 2024)
findings.correct_value: NAO report on AASC contracts published May 2025 (not March 2024) — original £4.5B ballooned to £15.3B over 10 years.

findings.claim: AASC 10-year deals from 2019 — Serco, Mears, Clearsprings
findings.correct_value: AASC contracts awarded 2019, 10-year term (2019-2029) across three providers.

findings.claim: Leonard Farruku death December 2023
findings.correct_value: Farruku (27, Albanian) died on Bibby Stockholm 12 December 2023.

findings.claim: SMP weekly rate doesn't apply; claim: Section 95 subsistence £49.18/week (2024)
findings.correct_value: Section 95 subsistence rate £49.18/week per person from April 2024.

findings.claim: Peak hotel population ~56,042 Sept 2023
findings.correct_value: Hotel population peaked at ~56,000 in Sept 2023 per Home Office stats.

findings.claim: Homes for Ukraine ~236,900 arrivals by April 2024
findings.correct_value: As of 2 April 2024, 145,900 arrivals under Homes for Ukraine (182,800 visas issued). 236,900 overstates by ~60%; ~302,000 figure may conflate all Ukraine schemes visas, not arrivals.

findings.claim: Martyn's Law (Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025) royal assent April 2025
findings.correct_value: Act received Royal Assent 3 April 2025; 24-month implementation period.

findings.claim: Martyn's Law tiers — 200-799 standard, 800+ enhanced
findings.correct_value: Standard tier 200-799 capacity; Enhanced tier 800+.

findings.claim: CT policing grant 2024-25 £1.15B
findings.correct_value: CT policing settlement 2024-25 ~£1.15B per Home Office police funding settlement.

findings.claim: Shawcross Prevent Review Feb 2023 — 34 recommendations
findings.correct_value: Shawcross Independent Review of Prevent published Feb 2023 with 34 recommendations; all accepted by HO.

findings.claim: UK threat level SEVERE since Nov 2024
findings.correct_value: MI5 threat level moved to SUBSTANTIAL Feb 2022; no authoritative recent MI5 statement confirming a Nov 2024 move to SEVERE located.

findings.claim: Weekly rate 2024-25 £81.90
findings.correct_value: Carer's Allowance 2024-25 = £81.90/week per Carers UK & DWP uprating.

findings.claim: Earnings limit £151/wk (April 2024) -> £196/wk (April 2025)
findings.correct_value: £151/week 2024-25; raised to £196/week from April 2025 in Autumn Budget 2024.

findings.claim: Scottish Carer Support Payment rollout Nov 2023-Apr 2024
findings.correct_value: Carer Support Payment phased launch from November 2023 with national rollout completed by April 2024.

findings.claim: Guardian April 2024 exposé: 134,800 carers owed DWP ~£250M
findings.correct_value: Guardian 6 April 2024 reported ~134,800 carers had overpayments totalling ~£251M.

findings.claim: Liz Sayce independent review commissioned Oct 2024
findings.correct_value: DWP commissioned Liz Sayce to lead independent review of Carer's Allowance overpayments; announced Oct 2024.

findings.claim: Virtual wards ~12,000 beds early 2024
findings.correct_value: NHSE data: virtual ward capacity reached ~12,325 by May 2024 (hit 10,000+ target for winter 2023-24).

findings.claim: Virtual ward target 50 per 100k population (Feb 2024 NHSE letter)
findings.correct_value: NHSE target 40-50 virtual ward beds per 100k population; as at late 2024 national average ~20/100k.

findings.claim: Darzi Review Sept 2024 diagnostic report
findings.correct_value: Lord Darzi 'Independent Investigation of the NHS in England' published September 2024.

findings.claim: Health visitor FTE 7,206 Sept 2024 vs 12,053 Oct 2015 (~40% decline)
findings.correct_value: NHS Digital/OHID workforce data shows health visitor FTE fell from ~12,000 in 2015 to ~7,000-7,200 in 2024, consistent with ~40% decline.

findings.claim: ScotRail nationalised 1 April 2022
findings.correct_value: ScotRail services transferred to public ownership under Scottish Rail Holdings on 1 April 2022.

findings.claim: Caledonian Sleeper nationalised 25 June 2023
findings.correct_value: SRH took over Caledonian Sleeper operations on 25 June 2023 following early termination of Serco contract.

findings.claim: Levenmouth Rail Link reopened 2 June 2024 — first new passenger rail line in Fife since 1969
findings.correct_value: Formal opening 29 May 2024 (FM Swinney); passenger services began 2 June 2024; first passenger rail in Levenmouth in 55+ years.

findings.claim: Network Rail reclassified into central government 1 Sept 2014
findings.correct_value: ONS reclassified Network Rail into central government sector on 1 September 2014 under ESA 2010.

findings.claim: Network Rail Scotland CP7 settlement £4.2B (2024-29)
findings.correct_value: ORR CP7 determination Oct 2023 set Scotland settlement at ~£4.2B for 2024-29 period.

findings.claim: 10 regional ambulance trusts in England
findings.correct_value: 10 regional ambulance trusts operating across England (LAS, SCAS, SECamb, SWAST, WMAS, EMAS, EEAST, YAS, NWAS, NEAS). IoW is a separate case.

findings.claim: Cat 1 target 7 min mean / 15 min 90th percentile
findings.correct_value: NHS Constitution/ARP targets: Cat 1 mean 7 min, 90th centile 15 min.

findings.claim: Cat 1 actual 2023-24 ~8m 30s mean
findings.correct_value: 2023-24 mean Cat 1 response time 8m 27s per Nuffield Trust/NHS England ambulance stats.

findings.claim: Cat 2 peak Dec 2022 ~1h 33m mean (vs 18-min target)
findings.correct_value: December 2022 mean Cat 2 ~93 minutes (well above original 18-min standard).

findings.claim: County-level ambulance merger to 10 strategic trusts in 2006 (Bradley Review 2004)
findings.correct_value: Taking Healthcare to the Patient (Bradley) 2005 led to consolidation into 10 regional trusts during 2006.

findings.claim: Environment Agency created 1996 under Environment Act 1995
findings.correct_value: EA established 1 April 1996 under the Environment Act 1995 (c. 25).

findings.claim: Chair Alan Lovell CBE from May 2022
findings.correct_value: Alan Lovell appointed Chair of EA May 2022.

findings.claim: CE Philip Duffy from 10 July 2023 (replacing Sir James Bevan)
findings.correct_value: Philip Duffy started as CE on 1 July 2023 (announced March 2023); entry says 10 July 2023.

findings.claim: Water (Special Measures) Act 2025 received Royal Assent 24 Feb 2025
findings.correct_value: Act received Royal Assent 24 February 2025.

findings.claim: DEFRA SoS 2024-25: Barclay to 4 Jul -> Steve Reed from 5 Jul
findings.correct_value: Steve Barclay was DEFRA SoS Nov 2023-Jul 2024 (correct); but immediate predecessor to Reed was Barclay. Therese Coffey preceded Barclay. Entry claim is OK but dates verified: Reed appointed 5 Jul 2024.

findings.claim: Sewage spills 2023: 464,056 events / ~3.6M hours
findings.correct_value: EA 2023 storm overflow data: 464,056 spills totalling ~3.6M hours.

findings.claim: UKSPF £2.6B over 2022-25 (successor to EU ESF + ERDF)
findings.correct_value: UKSPF provided £2.6B for 2022-25 as domestic replacement for EU Structural Funds.

findings.claim: UKSPF extended one year to 2025-26 at reduced £900M
findings.correct_value: UKSPF extended to 2025-26 with £902M (£234M capital, £668M revenue) at Autumn Budget 2024.

findings.claim: Levelling Up Fund £4.8B across 3 rounds 2021-25
findings.correct_value: LUF £4.8B total: Round 1 (~£1.7B, Oct 2021), Round 2 (£2.1B, Jan 2023), Round 3 (£1.1B, Nov 2023).

findings.claim: Long-Term Plan for Towns: 75 towns @ £20M each over 10 years
findings.correct_value: LTP for Towns announced Oct 2023 — 75 towns, £20M endowment-style funding each over 10 years.

findings.claim: English Devolution White Paper December 2024
findings.correct_value: MHCLG published English Devolution White Paper 16 December 2024.

findings.claim: 164 shire district councils in 2-tier areas
findings.correct_value: 164 lower-tier district/borough councils in England's two-tier areas (LGA/DCN figures).

findings.claim: Thurrock £1.5B debts 2022 — largest commercial-investment failure
findings.correct_value: Thurrock declared effectively bankrupt Dec 2022 with debts ~£1.5B; massive solar-bond investment losses. Note: Woking's 2023 crisis (£1.2B deficit) reported similar scale.

findings.claim: English Devolution White Paper signals unitary move by 2027-28
findings.correct_value: Dec 2024 White Paper signals replacement of 2-tier districts with unitaries via Strategic Authorities; timelines extend beyond 2027 for some areas.

findings.claim: DCN Oct 2024: 1-in-4 districts at s114 risk by 2026
findings.correct_value: District Councils' Network 'Local Voices' reports warned roughly a quarter of districts at s114 risk by 2026-27 absent reform.

findings.claim: Pensioner HB caseload ~1.5M (May 2024), ~65% of total HB headcount
findings.correct_value: DWP stats (Stat-Xplore): pensioner HB recipients ~1.5M May 2024, total HB ~2.3M; pensioner share ~65% headcount.

findings.claim: Mixed-age couple rule from 15 May 2019
findings.correct_value: Mixed-age couple (where one partner under SPA) routed to UC from 15 May 2019 instead of pensioner HB/PC.

findings.claim: Over-75 free TV licence tied to PC receipt from August 2020
findings.correct_value: BBC's means-tested over-75 TV licence implemented from 1 August 2020 — free only if PC recipient.

findings.claim: Housing Credit merger deferred from 2025 to 2028 at Autumn Budget 2024
findings.correct_value: Autumn Budget 2024 does not explicitly set 2028 merger date; HB/PC 'Housing Credit' merger originally planned for 2025 has been postponed but no firm 2028 date found in HMT docs.

findings.claim: England state-funded secondary Jan 2024: ~3.4M pupils, ~4,200 schools
findings.correct_value: DfE schools census Jan 2024: ~3.4M secondary pupils; ~4,000-4,200 state-funded secondary schools.

findings.claim: Academisation: ~82% of secondary pupils in academies
findings.correct_value: DfE reports ~82% of secondary pupils now attend academies/free schools (vs ~42% primary).

findings.claim: GCSE Summer 2024: 21.8% grade 7/A or above
findings.correct_value: Ofqual/JCQ: Summer 2024 21.8% of GCSE entries graded 7+/A or above.

findings.claim: PISA 2022 UK maths mean 489 (down from 502 in 2018)
findings.correct_value: OECD PISA 2022 UK maths mean 489, down from 502 in 2018.

findings.claim: ~230 state schools with RAAC confirmed Aug-Sept 2023
findings.correct_value: DfE confirmed ~230+ schools with RAAC by late 2023; figure later rose to ~240.

findings.claim: OfS established under HERA 2017, operational April 2018
findings.correct_value: Higher Education and Research Act 2017; OfS fully operational from 1 April 2018.

findings.claim: Chair Edward Peck CBE from Sep 2024 (replacing Lord Wharton)
findings.correct_value: Lord Wharton resigned shortly after July 2024 election; Prof Edward Peck became chair of OfS board in July 2025, not September 2024. There was an interim chair gap.

findings.claim: CEO Susan Lapworth continuing 2024-25 / Interim CE Philippa Pickford from Aug 2024
findings.correct_value: Susan Lapworth remained CE throughout 2024-25 and announced departure at Easter 2026 only in Dec 2025. Pickford was not interim CE in Aug 2024 — entry contradicts itself.

findings.claim: Tuition fee cap £9,250 → £9,535 from 2025-26 announced 4 Nov 2024 by Phillipson
findings.correct_value: Phillipson announced 4 November 2024 that max tuition fee rises from £9,250 to £9,535 from 2025-26 academic year.

findings.claim: University of Sussex £585k fine August 2024 on free-speech duty
findings.correct_value: OfS fined University of Sussex £585,000 in March 2025 (not August 2024) for breaches of consumer protection / free-speech related conditions.

findings.claim: Sir David Behan interim review July 2024
findings.correct_value: Sir David Behan's independent review of OfS commissioned under Labour July 2024.
SMP 2024-25 standard rate £184.03/wk; 2025-26 £187.18/wk (1.7% CPI uprating).

findings.claim: First 6 weeks: 90% of AWE; remaining 33 weeks: lower of £184.03 or 90% AWE
findings.correct_value: SMP structure: first 6 weeks 90% AWE uncapped; next 33 weeks at lower of standard rate or 90% AWE.

findings.claim: Employer recovery 92% standard / 103% for Small Employers' Relief (NI <£45,000)
findings.correct_value: Employers reclaim 92% of SMP; Small Employers' Relief lets eligible employers (Class 1 NIC ≤£45,000) reclaim 103%.

findings.claim: Paternity Leave (Amendment) Regulations 2024 in force 6 April 2024
findings.correct_value: Paternity Leave (Amendment) Regs 2024 (SI 2024/329) in force 8 March 2024; applies to births/placements from 6 April 2024.

findings.claim: Pre-April 2023 SME: 130% enhanced deduction · 14.5% payable credit
findings.correct_value: SME scheme pre-1 April 2023: 130% additional deduction; 14.5% payable credit for loss-makers.

findings.claim: April 2023-Mar 2024 SME: 86% enhanced deduction, 10% payable credit (general)
findings.correct_value: Enhanced deduction cut to 86% and payable credit to 10% from 1 April 2023.

findings.claim: ERIS 14.5% for loss-makers with ≥40% R&D intensity, lowered to ≥30% Apr 2024
findings.correct_value: Enhanced R&D Intensive Support: 14.5% payable credit; intensity threshold reduced from 40% to 30% from 1 April 2024.

findings.claim: PAYE cap on payable credit restored 2021 (Finance Act 2021)
findings.correct_value: PAYE cap (£20,000 + 300% PAYE/NIC) applies to payable SME R&D credits from accounting periods beginning on/after 1 April 2021 — Finance Act 2021.

findings.claim: SME eligibility: <500 staff AND (<€100M turnover OR <€86M balance sheet)
findings.correct_value: Aligns with EU SME definition used in CTA 2009 for R&D relief — <500 staff + €100M turnover OR €86M balance sheet.

key: Provision Of Defence Capability Other Costs And Services

findings.claim: UK lead nation NATO eFP in Estonia (Tapa) since 2017
findings.correct_value: UK has been NATO eFP lead nation at Tapa, Estonia, since 2017.

findings.claim: Op INTERFLEX trained ~30,000+ Ukrainian personnel by end-2024
findings.correct_value: Op INTERFLEX has trained ~37,000+ Ukrainian recruits by end 2024 (MoD figure).

findings.claim: MoD Cyber Directorate established 2020; NCF HQ Samlesbury announced 2021
findings.correct_value: MoD Cyber Directorate stood up 2020; National Cyber Force HQ at Samlesbury announced 2021.

findings.claim: Consultancy 20% cut target set 2023 (Cabinet Office Consultancy Playbook)
findings.correct_value: Cabinet Office Consultancy Playbook updated 2023; 20% reduction target across govt; MoD consultancy ~£150M/yr per NAO/PAC.
